title: Wound Ripper

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Wound Ripper is the upgraded form of Ripper using Bloodstone. Like all upgraded-weapons that use Bloodstone, their hit effect is damage increased by 0.2% for every point of health the player is missing (not the percentage missing).
An upgraded Ripper will NOT keep its upgrade level when it is modified using gemstones.
